rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=4, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=800, outer_wall_s=1500, lr=0.001, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-2 ONE-KNOB: n_iter 400->800 (per-scan Adam steps doubled), all else held at iter-1. HYPOTHESIS (per-scan-fit-undershoot): iter-1 val_score 0.9501 / hr +0.1065 already beats LD-FBP, but the per-image self-supervised fit ran only 400 Adam steps on each val scans own measurements and may be undershooting the per-image optimum; doubling to 800 steps lets each scan settle closer to convergence and should lift val_score above 0.9501. To keep iter-2 wall <=15 min per six-box box-5, val_n dropped 6->4 (smoke ~0.25 s/(iter x scene): warm ~150s + 4x800x0.25 ~800s ~16 min; outer_wall_s=1500 caps it). DO NOT revert to amortized; this is the per-image N2I rewrite (commit 1f4c3394).
